title: Galaktoboureko Crème Brûlée
description: A creamy Galaktoboureko-inspired dessert with a caramelized sugar crust, French flair, and a velvety texture.
instructions: 2. In a medium bowl, whisk together the greek yogurt, velvety cream, eggs, and granulated sugar.

6. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the edges are golden brown.
7. Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
8. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
9. Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of granulated sugar on top.
